snippet.description:
Did this ancient carving reveal a forgotten egyptian object?

Ancient carvings can preserve stories, symbols, and objects from civilizations that existed thousands of years ago. But this particular relief contains a detail that looks surprisingly unusual. A small, highlighted object appears among the surrounding figures and hieroglyphs, making it easy to wonder what its original purpose might have been.

Could it represent a ceremonial item, a symbolic object, or something completely different? The carving itself may hold clues but its true meaning remains open to interpretation.

What do you think the ancient artist was trying to show here? 
.
.
.
 #ancientcarving #egyptianhistory #AncientMystery #archaeology

snippet.description:
You can collect 800 model answers. Even 1,600 more won't automatically make you exam-ready.

So what actually helps?

In this conversation, Nikhil Sir and Vishal Sir explain why simply reading model answers isn't enough for UPSC Mains. Answer writing requires a process, practice and active involvement, not just more material to consume.

That is why the course has been restructured to make preparation more intensive, practical and engaging.
